en.name: Whole wheat bread, sliced
en.summary: A commercially baked, pre-sliced wholemeal loaf keeps 3–5 days at room temperature in its bag and 3 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). Refrigeration is not recommended: bread goes stale faster in a fridge than it does on the counter.
en.pantry: Keep the loaf in its own bag, closed, at cool room temperature and out of the sun: 3–5 days. A bread bin or a cupboard away from the hob is ideal, since warmth and humidity are what bring on mould, and pre-sliced bread has far more cut surface exposed than a whole loaf. Do not store it in the sunlight on top of the fridge, which is the warmest spot in most kitchens. Wholemeal loaves carry the germ and its oil, so they also go stale-tasting a little faster than white.
en.fridge: Refrigeration is not recommended. Bread stales by starch retrogradation, and that happens fastest just above freezing — so a loaf in the fridge goes dry and crumbly considerably faster than the same loaf on the counter, while gaining you very little against mould. If your kitchen is so hot and humid that the loaf moulds within a couple of days, the answer is the freezer, not the fridge.
en.freezer: Freeze it for 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F), which is the right move for anything you will not eat within the first few days. Freeze it sliced, in the bag, inside a second freezer bag with the air pressed out, and take out slices as you need them — a pre-sliced loaf is ideally shaped for this. Toast slices straight from frozen; they come back far better than refrigerated bread does. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality.
en.thawing: Toast slices straight from frozen, or leave them on a rack at room temperature for a few minutes. Do not thaw a whole loaf in the fridge — that is the one place bread stales fastest.
spoilage: Any mould spot, whatever the colour, including on a single slice inside the bag.
A musty or alcoholic smell when the bag is opened.
Slices gone dry, hard and crumbling at the edges — stale rather than unsafe.
A sticky, ropy crumb that pulls into threads, which means the whole loaf goes.
tips: Freeze half the loaf on the day you buy it if you eat bread slowly.
Close the bag properly; an open bag stales a loaf in a day.
Do not store bread on top of the fridge — it is the warmest place in the kitchen.
Throw the whole loaf out if you find mould; do not pick out the good slices.

faq.q: How long does sliced wholemeal bread keep?
faq.a: 3–5 days at cool room temperature in its bag, or 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Should bread be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: No. Refrigeration is not recommended — bread dries out and stales quickly in a fridge. Freeze it instead.

faq.q: Can you cut mould off bread?
faq.a: No. Mould on bread spreads invisibly through the soft crumb, so discard the loaf rather than the slice.

zh.name: 全麥吐司（市售切片）
zh.summary: 市售烘焙、預先切片的全麥吐司，維持原包裝放在室溫可放 3～5 天，−18 °C 冷凍 3 個月。不建議冷藏：麵包在冰箱裡走味的速度比放在檯面上更快。
zh.pantry: 維持原本的袋子、封好口，放在涼爽、不曬太陽的室溫：3～5 天。麵包箱或遠離爐火的櫥櫃最理想，因為溫熱和濕氣正是長霉的推手，而預先切片的麵包暴露的切面又遠多於整條。不要放在冰箱上面又曬到太陽的位置，那通常是廚房裡最熱的地方。全麥吐司帶著胚芽和油脂，走味也會比白吐司稍快一些。
zh.fridge: 不建議冷藏。麵包變硬走味是澱粉老化造成的，而那在略高於冰點的溫度下發生得最快——所以放冰箱的吐司會比放檯面上的同一條乾得快、碎得快，對防霉的幫助卻很有限。如果你的廚房濕熱到麵包兩三天就發霉，答案是冷凍庫，不是冷藏室。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 冷凍 3 個月；頭幾天內吃不完的，這就是正解。連袋整條切片冷凍，外面再套一個冷凍袋壓出空氣，要吃幾片拿幾片——預先切片的吐司天生就適合這樣。直接從冷凍下烤箱或烤麵包機，回復的程度遠勝冷藏過的麵包。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。
zh.thawing: 直接從冷凍烤，或放在網架上室溫回溫幾分鐘。不要把整條放冷藏解凍——那正是麵包老化最快的地方。
spoilage: 出現任何顏色的霉點，包括袋子裡某一片上的。
拆袋時聞到霉味或酒精味。
麵包變乾、變硬、邊緣碎裂——那是走味而不是不安全。
麵包心變得黏稠牽絲，那種情況整條都要丟。
tips: 吃得慢的話，買回來當天就把半條冷凍。
袋口確實封好；敞著一天就乾了。
不要把麵包放在冰箱上方——那是廚房裡最熱的位置。
看到霉就整條丟掉，不要挑看起來沒事的那幾片。

faq.q: 切片全麥吐司可以放多久？
faq.a: 維持包裝放涼爽室溫 3～5 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 3 個月。
不要。不建議冷藏——麵包在冰箱裡會迅速變乾變硬。要保存請冷凍。

faq.q: 麵包發霉可以把霉切掉嗎？
faq.a: 不行。霉會在鬆軟的麵包心裡看不見地擴散，請整條丟棄，不要只丟那一片。
